generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
GST Registration from Competent authority is compulsory

As per Karnataka state government order No. LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27.7.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund. The tenderer shall abide by the directions of Government towards recovery as modified by the Government from time to time
Before tendering for the works the tenderer may inspect the site personally to know the nature of work and working condition
For other necessary document as per tender bid document KW1/KW2 and Notification Addendum/Corrigendum will be published in the office notice board for all modifications/corrections, if any

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: The PWD Contractor Civil Registration Certificate Government
The works is reserved for Schedule Caste SC Contractors tenderers only. Hence the tenderers should upload the original Cast Certificate issued by the competent Authority

Schedule Caste / Schedule Tribes/CAT-I / CAT-II A Contractor should be domicile of the State of Karnataka only for more than 10 years. For the proof Residential Certificate issued by the competent authority should be uploaded

Annual Turnover Certificate in all classes of Civil Engineering works only for last Five Financial years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26Certified from Charted Accountant Profit and Loss, balance sheet shall be enclosed and UDI number

Work done Certificate For Schedule Caste /Schedule Tribes/ CAT-I / CAT-II A Category Contractors KW1/KW2 of this notification Construction/Improvement/Repair of Building Works of this notification value not less than 25 Percentage of the amount put to tender in any one of the last five financial year period 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26

Tender Capacity as per KW1/KW2 for Schedule Caste / Schedule Tribes/ CAT-I / CAT-II A Eligible Tenderers will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under for General Assessed available tender Bid Document KW1/KW2 and also mentioned in Notification

As per PWD Code 251Jurisdiction Contractors registered under class I and II may ender for works anywhere in the state. Contractors registered under class III may tender for works within the districts of the Public works Department circles wherein they are registered. Contractors registered under Class IV may tender for works within the district or within the division whichever is applicable, where they are registered These registrations are valid for all
For Other Necessary Document as per Tender Bid Document KW/KW2 and Notification

itemList.description: Providing and laying of 1.5 mm thick SBS modified self adhesive single stick waterproofing membrane, with minimum elongation of 300%  and puncture resistance of  200 N (as per ASTM E154), with an overlap of 100mm on the side and 100mm in vertical lapping over a coat bituminuos primer @ 0.25 l/m2, complete including surface preparation as per the methodology and site condition & placing the dimple board over the SBS membrane. The cost is inclusive of surface preparation, crack filling, repair of loose mortar etc. completely as per specification. Styrene Butadiene Styrene (SBS) based. (SR-2023-24, Volume-II, Chapter-15,Page No.149, Item No.15.3)

Providing and fixing 1mm thick M.S. sheet door with frame of 40x40x6 mm  angle  iron  and  3  mm  M.S.  gusset  plates  at  the junctions  and corners,  all  necessary  fittings  complete,  including applying a priming coat of approved steel primer. Using M.S. angels 40x40x6 mm for diagonal braces   including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in- Charge. (SR-2023-24, Volume II, Chapter-11, Page No.77.0,Item No. 11.5.1)

Providing and constructing load bearing wall with Solid Concrete blocks of  size  400x150x200mm  having  block  density  more  than  1800kg/m3 and  minimum  compressive  strength  of  4.00  N/mm2  conforming  to  IS 2185 (Part - I) - 2005 and constructed with CM 1:4 as per IS 2572:2005 including  cost  of  all  materials,  labour,  scaffolding  and  curing,  usage charges of machinery etc complete as per specifications.(SR-2023-24, Volume II, Chapter-06, Page No.17.0, Item No. 6.33)

Providing   15 mm cement plaster on the rough side of single or half brick wall of mix :1:6 (1 cement: 6 fine sand)   including rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.(SR-2023-24, Volume II, Chapter-08, Page No.41.0, Item No. 8.2.2)
Repairing  and  fixing  shutters  (panelled  or  glazed)  to  doors,  windows, ventilators and cupboards. (SR-2023-24, Volume-II, Chapter-20,Page No.207, Item No.20.104)

Providing and fixing 1mm thick M.S. sheet door with frame of 40x40x6 mm  angle  iron  and  3  mm  M.S.  gusset  plates  at  the junctions  and corners,  all  necessary  fittings  complete,  including applying a priming coat of approved steel primer. Using M.S. angels 40x40x6 mm for diagonal braces   including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in- Charge. (SR-2023-24, Volume II, Chapter-11, Page No.77.0,Item No. 11.5.1)

Distempering  with  oil  bound  washable  distemper  of  approved brand and manufacture to give an even shade :New work (two coats) over and in- cluding water thinnable priming coat with cement primer  after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge. (SR-2023-24, Volume II, Chapter-08, Page No.45.0, Item No. 8.25)
